primary_meaning: Spiritual rest in Christ and the ultimate eschatological rest of God's people, representing the cessation of works-righteousness and the peace of salvation.

alternatives.meaning: The Lord's Day (Sunday) as a transferred Christian Sabbath, serving as a weekly memorial of the resurrection and a foretaste of eternal rest.
A binding, literal seventh-day (Saturday) observance of physical rest, viewed as an eternal sign of God's covenant and authority over creation.
A chronological typology pointing to a literal Millennial Kingdom, representing a thousand-year period of peace corresponding to the seventh day of creation.

notes: While there is broad consensus on the symbolic meaning of the Sabbath as spiritual and eschatological rest in Christ, there remains intense division over its literal application. Traditions are split between Lord's Day Sabbatarianism, Seventh-Day Sabbatarianism, and views that see the weekly command as entirely fulfilled and thus abrogated.
